about_the_game:
Farm your Land - Defend your Island

Step into a world where farming meets strategy! Cultivate your land, raise animals, and gather resources to thrive on your lush island. But beware—waves of invaders are on the horizon, eager to plunder your hard-earned bounty. Build strong defenses, devise clever strategies, and fend off the attackers to keep your island paradise safe. Can you master the balance between farming and fortification? The survival of your island is in your hands!

Your villagers are the heart of your island. Each villager comes with unique abilities that can be upgraded over time—whether it's enhancing their farming skills, boosting their defensive prowess, or unlocking new powers that turn the tide in battle. Invest in your villagers, train them well, and watch as they evolve from humble farmers to powerful defenders, ready to protect your island from any threat.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
